name: uwe
description: Universeller Welten-Editor — self-hosted campaign brain and world wiki

scripts.build:release: pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && pnpm build && pnpm build:standalone-check
scripts.build:standalone-check: node scripts/check-standalone-prisma-deps.mjs studio && node scripts/check-standalone-prisma-deps.mjs portal
scripts.ci:check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:ci && pnpm build:release
scripts.ci:light: pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:ci && pnpm secret:scan && pnpm docs:check
scripts.quality: pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && pnpm lint && pnpm secret:scan && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:security && pnpm audit:prod && pnpm build:release && node scripts/bundle-budget-check.mjs
scripts.test:ci: pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && node scripts/migration-check.mjs && turbo run test && node --import tsx --test scripts/selfhost.test.ts scripts/release.test.ts scripts/integration-smoke.test.ts scripts/client-server-boundary.test.ts
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && turbo run test && node --import tsx --test scripts/selfhost.test.ts scripts/release.test.ts scripts/integration-smoke.test.ts scripts/client-server-boundary.test.ts scripts/bundle-budget.test.ts scripts/perf-budget.test.ts scripts/stress-scale.test.ts
scripts.test:security: pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && pnpm --filter @uwe/security-tests test && node --import tsx --test scripts/studio-route-auth.test.ts scripts/security-leaks.test.ts
scripts.test:auth: pnpm --filter @uwe/auth test && pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && node --import tsx --test packages/database/src/password-security.test.ts packages/database/src/auth-setup.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:perf: pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && playwright test studio-perf portal-perf
scripts.test:e2e:a11y: pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && playwright test e2e/studio-a11y.spec.ts e2e/portal-a11y.spec.ts
scripts.qa:theme-matrix: pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && QA_MATRIX=1 playwright test studio-qa-matrix portal-qa-matrix
scripts.test:postgres-smoke: pnpm --filter @uwe/database db:generate && pnpm --filter @uwe/database exec node --import tsx --test src/postgres-smoke.test.ts
